scenes.title: The Alarm
scenes.headline: FIVE INCOMING NUCLEAR MISSILES
scenes.voiceover_text: At 00:15 Moscow time, emergency sirens split Serpukhov-15. Five American nuclear warheads were reported ascending toward the Soviet Union.
scenes.cosyvoice_instruct: Controlled urgency and mounting dread, deep authoritative baritone documentary tone, crisp articulation.

nolan_direction.shot_a_drama: Stanislav Petrov frozen under flashing red beacon, chiaroscuro lighting on sweat-drenched brow
nolan_direction.shot_b_macro: Macro CRT radar sweep revealing five trajectory spikes blinking in Cyrillic phosphorus

scenes.title: The Satellites
scenes.headline: SOVIET OKO SATELLITE WARNING
scenes.voiceover_text: In high orbit, Soviet Oko satellites confirmed the infrared launches. The central computer classified the attack with maximum certainty.
scenes.cosyvoice_instruct: Cold mechanical precision, chilling documentary baritone, emphasizing technological infallibility.

nolan_direction.shot_a_drama: Silhouetted satellite telemetry tech staring at phosphor displays reflecting in eyeglasses
nolan_direction.shot_b_macro: Orbital optical lens aperture catching blinding sunlight reflection above cloud decks

scenes.title: The Protocol
scenes.headline: PROTOCOL ORDERS IMMEDIATE RETALIATION
scenes.telemetry: STRATEGIC ROCKET FORCES // RETALIATION READY // T-MINUS 20:00
scenes.voiceover_text: Military protocol demanded an immediate full-scale counterstrike. Soviet nuclear silos stood unlocked and armed for total retaliation.
scenes.cosyvoice_instruct: Grim, somber weight, tragic historical gravitas, heavy cadence.

nolan_direction.shot_a_drama: Heavy black Bakelite telephone receiver trembling in duty officer hand
nolan_direction.shot_b_macro: Industrial toggle switches clicking into launch posture under harsh desk lamp

scenes.title: The Human Choice
scenes.headline: ONE OFFICER CALLS A GLITCH
scenes.telemetry: BUNKER COMMAND CONSOLE // OVERRIDE LOG // FALSE ALARM
scenes.voiceover_text: Instead of authorizing armageddon, duty officer Stanislav Petrov trusted human instinct over flawed machines. He called it a glitch.
scenes.cosyvoice_instruct: Intense suspense turning to calm defiance, deliberate pauses, revelation delivered with profound philosophical mystery.

nolan_direction.shot_a_drama: Close-up of Petrov inhaling cigarette smoke, eyes fixed on the blank confirmation board
nolan_direction.shot_b_macro: Extreme macro of finger lingering 5 millimeters above the heavy red authorization button

scenes.title: The Climax & Lockup
scenes.headline: TWENTY MINUTES TO MIDNIGHT
scenes.voiceover_text: Twenty minutes decided the survival of human civilization. The untold classified story of the glitch that saved the world.
scenes.cosyvoice_instruct: Cinematic climax resolution, powerful resonant documentary tone, unforgettable final statement.

nolan_direction.shot_a_drama: Petrov slumped back into leather chair as radar clears to zero targets, dawn light creeping in
nolan_direction.shot_b_macro: Dossier folder snapping shut with crimson stamp: TOP SECRET // DECLASSIFIED
